claims.claim: FP16 autocast training commonly uses gradient scaling; unscale must precede gradient clipping.
claims.verification_note: PyTorch official sequence and skip semantics.

claims.claim: Modern PyTorch API supports torch.autocast and torch.amp.GradScaler for CUDA mixed precision training.
claims.verification_note: Code is an operational skeleton, not a performance result.

claims.claim: FlashAttention uses IO-aware tiling and online softmax to reduce GPU high-bandwidth-memory reads/writes without materializing the full attention matrix.
claims.verification_note: Exact dense attention is preserved within numerical tolerances.

claims.claim: FlashAttention is not an algorithm that reduces exact dense self-attention arithmetic complexity to linear sequence length.
claims.verification_note: Separates IO complexity from arithmetic operation count.

claims.claim: Activation checkpointing saves activation memory by recomputing activations during backpropagation.
claims.verification_note: Memory-versus-compute tradeoff, not reduced parameter count.

claims.claim: PyTorch SDPA selects eligible implementations conditionally according to dtype, device and mask.
claims.verification_note: Implementation-dependent kernel selection must be profiled.
